title: Mank
favouriteScene: Mank's drunken monologue at San Simeon dismantling William Randolph Hearst's organ-grinder monkey fable.
favouritePerformance: Gary Oldman as Herman J. Mankiewicz
personalReflections: A sumptuous, monochrome love letter to the messy, painful compromises behind great art. Rich in historical subtext and bitter intellectual wit.
